title: Set room status

help.available: Releases the selected dates from any operational status.
help.blocked: Withholds the room from sale while it remains usable.
help.out-of-service: The room cannot be used because of maintenance or damage.
help.needs-cleaning: The room must be prepared before the next guest.

dates-help: Choose one day or a range. Existing statuses in the range are replaced.
booking-note: Days with a booking or stay are controlled by that booking.
